# Noto Animated Emoji

The animated emoji GIFs bundled in `Resources/Data/NotoOffline/gifs` are
unmodified works from **Noto Animated Emoji by Google**.

- Project and attribution source:
  https://googlefonts.github.io/noto-emoji-animation/
- Original asset pattern:
  `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/latest/{codepoint}/512.gif`
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Retrieved: 2026-07-27
- Modifications: None

The exact source codepoint, byte count, and SHA-256 digest for every bundled
asset are recorded in `Resources/Data/NotoOffline/noto-offline-manifest.json`.
